description: This file defines API endpoints for managing medical appointments within a healthcare system. It includes functions for booking appointments, confirming or rejecting them by doctors, and retrieving appointment data based on user roles. The file integrates FastAPI route definitions, dependency injections, and database interactions, and it serves as a core component for appointment management features.

methods.name: models.Patient get_current_patient( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Returns the Patient ORM object for the currently authenticated user, raises exceptions if not permitted or profile not found.

methods.name: models.Doctor get_current_doctor( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Returns the Doctor ORM object for the currently authenticated user, raises exceptions if not permitted or profile not found.

methods.name: book_appointment( payload: schemas.AppointmentCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), patient: models.Patient = Depends(get_current_patient), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Handles patient booking of an appointment slot, creating appointment and notification records in the database.

methods.name: confirm_or_reject_appointment( appointment_id: int, status_req: AppointmentStatusChangeRequest, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), doctor: models.Doctor = Depends(get_current_doctor), )
methods.description: Allows a doctor to confirm or reject a pending appointment, updates appointment status, manages related timeslot and notifications.

methods.name: list_my_appointments( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves all appointments for the current user, filtering based on whether they are a patient or doctor.

methods.name: get_appointment_by_id( appointment_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Fetches an appointment by its ID if the current user is involved (as patient or doctor).
